newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish debt yields end flat in upbeat market.
newsitem.headline: Swedish debt yields end flat in upbeat market.

text.p: 1530 GMT - Swedish debt yields were virtually unchanged on Tuesday in quite trade. Market focus was on the U.S. FOMC meeting, the French election and information about the Sweden's stance on the European economic and monetary union, which is expected to be revealed soon. * Six month T-bill rates slip two basis points to 4.18 percent * Ten-year bond yields flat at 7.00 percent * Crown firms to 4.5175 against the mark versus 4.5200 Monday
Swedish debt yields ended flat on Tuesday amid upbeat sentiment.
Ten year bond yields tried to break a support level at 7.00 percent, but failed.
"Now we've been there three times. Next time it will succeed. There have been opportunities to sell several times, but nothing has happened," one dealer said.
Dealers said the undertone was positive. The crown and Swedish yields have underperformed substantially since the beginning of the year, they said.
